slides.3.title: The Four Algarve DOCs
slides.3.html:
Algarve is Portugal's southernmost wine region, with four DOCs spread along the Atlantic coastline from west to east.

🗺️ The four DOCs

DOC Location Character
Lagos Far west, Atlantic coast Red cliff coast, sandstone and limestone, traditional winemaking, closest to the Atlantic
Portimão West-central Modern facilities, international tourism driving quality improvement
Lagoa Central The oldest wine centre in the Algarve, limestone uplands, Lagoa cooperative
Tavira Far east, close to Spain Hottest and driest, Andalucía-like terroir, mainly Negra Mole and Periquita

🍇 Main varieties

  • Red: Negra Mole・Castelão (= Periquita)・Touriga Nacional・Syrah
  • White: Síria (Roupeiro)・Arinto・Crato Branco
  • International varieties such as Viognier and Grenache are also planted in recent years (labelled as IGP Algarve)

slides.6.title: Algarve vs. Alentejo: Two Southern Regions Compared
slides.6.items.0.label: Algarve (far south)
slides.6.items.0.desc: Along the coastline, with both Atlantic and Mediterranean influence and abundant sunshine; tourism drives development, with mainly fresh reds
slides.6.items.1.label: Alentejo (southern plains)
slides.6.items.1.desc: Vast inland plains, purely Mediterranean and hotter and drier. Eight sub-regions with varied soils, and the DOC with Portugal's largest export volume
slides.6.items.2.label: Common ground
slides.6.items.2.desc: Both have a Mediterranean climate with over 3,000 hours of sunshine a year, produce rounded, rich reds, and share several main varieties
slides.6.items.3.label: Trends
slides.6.items.3.desc: The Algarve is threatened by climate change (hotter summers), and winemakers are starting to explore high-altitude inland areas (Serra de Monchique)
slides.7.question: What is the Algarve's most distinctive native red grape variety?
slides.7.explanation: Negra Mole is the Algarve's most distinctive native variety, grown almost exclusively in southern Portugal. Its name means "soft black", and it makes deeply coloured reds with red berry and spice notes and a smooth palate, the signature variety of the Algarve.
slides.8.question: How many DOCs does the Algarve have, and what are they from west to east?
slides.8.explanation: The Algarve has four DOCs, from west to east: Lagos (westernmost)・Portimão・Lagoa (the oldest)・Tavira (easternmost, close to Spain). All four lie along the Algarve coastline.
